detail.title: LLM Reasoning Blind Spot Identification
detail.question: To what extent can Large Language Models systematically identify and navigate 'blind spots' in their own generated thought structures?
detail.reason: Current reasoning methods often rely on previously generated logical directions, creating unexplored solution spaces; identifying these blind spots is critical to improving model reliability.

children.title: Revision of LLM Reasoning Blind Spots and Epistemic Awareness

detail.title: Revision of LLM Reasoning Blind Spots and Epistemic Awareness
detail.summary: LLM reasoning blind spots, modeled as failures in heuristic search path selection, are confirmed by recent EACL 2026 findings to be computationally constrained by node generation costs in A* search frameworks.
detail.reason: Incorporating EACL 2026 evidence to bridge heuristic search limitations with broader computational linguistics findings.

children.title: Thought Space Explorer framework methodology empirical limitations in epistemic self-correction

detail.reason: The TSE framework currently serves as a primary model for navigating blind spots; we need to clarify its limitations regarding true self-correction versus heuristic search expansion to meet notebook synthesis standards.
